name: Gala Global Products Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2010, Gala Global Products Ltd provides a range of multipurpose stationeries

keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GGPL is a Gujarat-based company that undertakes offset printing and all types of binding, photo polymer printing, offset plate making, letter press printing, allied
lines in offset printing, and printing of packing materials, advertisement materials, and cartons.
